description: List the safety data sheets in your own SDSentry inventory that need attention, each with a link: sheets whose file changed at their SDS link since the copy on record, sheets not marked reviewed in the last 365 days (SDSentry's review reminder interval), sheets whose text may not name the product, and products with no SDS on file. Needs a personal SDSentry access token (created by the account owner in SDSentry, Admin, AI assistants) and an account on a free trial or a paid plan. Read-only; reads only that account's data.
name: sheets_due_for_review
title: Safety data sheets in my SDSentry inventory that need attention
